title: Executable Specification Builder: Concept Specification
description: Executable Specification Builder — Concept Specification. Turns requirements into testable contracts, validation rules, and candidate implementations.
body: The Executable Specification Builder (catalog entry 683, AI and Software Supertools) is a proposed Signature-original capability for the JAH Network apex simulator-generator family. Turns requirements into testable contracts, validation rules, and candidate implementations. This concept specification states the problem it solves, the class of inputs it accepts, and the class of outputs it promises. It is designed to live in the Signature ecosystem alongside the other apex tools: it exchanges tool definitions, simulation results, and evidence packs through the shared apex registry, and every artifact it produces is expected to carry its provenance, tests, and recorded results with it. This record describes a PROPOSED capability, not a completed product. Nothing here claims the tool has been built, independently verified, or deployed. Design rule: a generated tool is NOT marked operational until it has a defined interface, a successful build, meaningful tests, and recorded results.

Turns requirements into testable contracts, validation rules, and candidate implementations. This evidence protocol defines what gets recorded for every run: the input specification, the tool version, the seed, the full output, the test outcomes, and a content hash binding them together.
